title: Drop Casting Polymer to Silicon Wafer
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Prepare CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file with the header columns: Well, Transfer Volume Solution 1 (ul), Transfer Volume Solution 2 (ul), Transfer Volume Solution 3 (ul), Transfer Volume to Silicon Plate (ul). Fill each row (starting with A1, B1, C1, …) with the desired volumes for each sample; all volumes must be between 0 and 20 µL. The first row must contain the headers and the rows must be ordered up to the Number of Samples you will run.

steps.title: Load CSV and set parameters
steps.instruction: Upload the CSV into the protocol, specify the Number of Samples, choose the silicon‑wafer grid size (24, 48, or 96 wells) to set the spacing between drops, and set the Dispense Height Above Wafer (0 returns the wafer top, 1 returns 1 mm above the top, etc.).

steps.title: Transfer polymer solutions to mix plate
steps.instruction: For each sample well listed in the CSV, perform the following transfers using a pipette tip that is returned after each aspiration:

substeps.instruction: Transfer the listed volume (0‑20 µL) of Solution 1 from tube A1 to the target well (e.g., A1). Return tip.
Transfer the listed volume (0‑20 µL) of Solution 2 from tube A2 to the same well. Return tip.
Transfer the listed volume (0‑20 µL) of Solution 3 from tube A3 to the well indicated for that sample (e.g., A2 if the CSV row specifies well A2). Return tip.

steps.title: Mix each well
steps.instruction: Using a fresh pipette tip, mix the contents of each sample well (e.g., Well A1) to obtain a homogeneous polymer mixture.

steps.title: Deposit mixed sample onto wafer
steps.instruction: At the previously set Dispense Height Above Wafer, aspirate the Transfer Volume to Silicon Plate (0‑20 µL) from the mixed well and dispense it onto the corresponding position on the silicon wafer (e.g., well A1 to wafer position A1, B1 to B1, etc.).

steps.title: Dispose of tip
steps.instruction: After each deposition, discard the used pipette tip.
